description: This file defines the EmailSubscriber entity class for the OrangeHRM system, mapping to the 'ohrm_email_subscriber' database table using Doctrine ORM. It includes properties for id, name, email, and a relationship to EmailNotification, along with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: EmailSubscriber
classes.description: Entity class representing an email subscriber with properties for id, name, email, and linked email notification.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the email subscriber.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the email subscriber.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the subscriber.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the subscriber.

methods.name: getEmail
methods.description: Returns the email address of the subscriber.

methods.name: setEmail
methods.description: Sets the email address of the subscriber.

methods.name: setEmailNotification
methods.description: Associates an EmailNotification entity with this subscriber.
